shortcut.specialoptionskeeptextonly.note: PROMOTED: bare Ctrl+T is bound in editor.js (pasteTextOnly, same path as Ctrl+Shift+V) — OO SpecialOptionsKeepTextOnly

shortcut.inserttab.note: PROMOTED: Tab block fallback inserts a tab character in plain body (OO InsertTab); object/table/list/form contexts keep their handlers

shortcut.mixedindent.note: PROMOTED: Tab inside a list item indents it (OO MixedIndent — the list-context Tab branch, execCommand indent, native undoable)

shortcut.mixedunindent.note: PROMOTED: Shift+Tab inside a nested list item outdents it (OO MixedUnIndent — execCommand outdent)

shortcut.equationchangealignmentright.note: PROMOTED: Tab with an equation selected aligns right (OO EquationChangeAlignmentRight) — data-eq-align attr + margin auto, round-trips via data-spec

shortcut.equationchangealignmentleft.note: PROMOTED: Shift+Tab with an equation selected aligns left (OO EquationChangeAlignmentLeft)

shortcut.movetonextform.note: PROMOTED: Tab from inside a form control focuses the next .wo-form-field control (OO MoveToNextForm)

shortcut.movetopreviousform.note: PROMOTED: Shift+Tab from inside a form control focuses the previous one (OO MoveToPreviousForm)

shortcut.choosenextcomboboxoption.note: PROMOTED: ArrowDown in a dropdown form field picks the next option and emits wo:field-op (OO ChooseNextComboBoxOption)

shortcut.choosepreviouscomboboxoption.note: PROMOTED: ArrowUp in a dropdown form field picks the previous option and emits wo:field-op (OO ChoosePreviousComboBoxOption)

shortcut.insertlinebreakmultilineform.note: PROMOTED: Enter inside a multiline form field inserts a line break instead of splitting the paragraph (OO InsertLineBreakMultilineForm; new Forms-tab multiline field)

shortcut.movetoupperheader.note: PROMOTED: Alt+PageUp with a page header present moves the caret into it (OO MoveToUpperHeader); without page parts Alt+Page stays page-start nav

shortcut.movetolowerheader.note: PROMOTED: Alt+PageDown with a page footer present moves the caret into it (OO MoveToLowerHeader)

shortcut.movetoupperheaderfooter.note: PROMOTED: bare PageUp on the first page with a header present jumps into the header (OO MoveToUpperHeaderFooter); mid-document paging stays native

shortcut.movetolowerheaderfooter.note: PROMOTED: bare PageDown on the last page with a footer present jumps into the footer (OO MoveToLowerHeaderFooter)

ctx.edit-wrap-boundary.note: PROMOTED: loud-limited divergence has a real observable — the wo:edit-wrap-boundary CustomEvent with detail {available:false, onObject:true} is the honest WO surface until a vector contour model exists

ctx.edit-points.note: PROMOTED: wo:edit-points CustomEvent marker is the observable (no shape contour editor subsystem; status + console marker per WO-22 decision)
